actionability_choice.instructions: You are an expert in static analysis warning classification. Decide whether this static-analysis warning is actionable. Actionable means a real issue that developers should fix; unactionable means a false positive or noise that does not need a fix. Select exactly one option.

criteria.actionable: A genuine defect or risk that warrants developer attention and a code change.
criteria.unactionable: A false positive, intentional pattern, or warning that does not require a fix.
